overall_notes: The paper focuses on gender accuracy in machine translation using a novel self-training approach. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some refinement for specificity and normalization. The paper uses both automatic metrics (gender accuracy metrics, BLEU) and human evaluations (gender accuracy and quality ratings).
